say:2:1423370001:1.text: Yeah, isn't it time for class? Why are we still waiting?
say:2:1423370001:1.source_cn: 老师，是不是到上课的时间了，怎么还不开始上课呀？

say:3:1423370002:1.text: Jules, do you know where Sheena is? She didn't come to class... We can't just leave her out there.
say:3:1423370002:1.source_cn: 朱尔，你知道希娜去哪了吗？她没有来上课……我们不能丢下...

say:4:1423370003:1.text: Sheena told me she's not coming back... Should we still wait?
say:4:1423370003:1.source_cn: 老师，希娜跟我说过……她不会来了。我们真的要等她吗？

say:5:1423370004:1.text: Can you tell me what else she said?
say:5:1423370004:1.source_cn: 可以跟老师讲讲，她还跟你说了些什么吗？

say:6:1423370005:1.text: She kept saying things like, "Orlana will go back to the royal city soon" and "She's just here for fun and will leave us eventually." Someone argued back, and she ran off.
say:6:1423370005:1.source_cn: 她一直跟我们说“欧罗娜很快就会回王城的”“她只是一时兴...

say:7:1423370006:1.text: Do you think... she feels like we gave up on her? But she won't even come to class...
say:7:1423370006:1.source_cn: 希娜会不会觉得我们抛弃了她……可是，她又不愿意来上课……

choice_prompt:8:1423370006.text: Do you think... she feels like we gave up on her? But she won't even come to class...
choice_prompt:8:1423370006.source_cn: 希娜会不会觉得我们抛弃了她……可是，她又不愿意来上课……

say:9:1423370007:1.text: She went south. If I had to guess, she's out hunting. That's what she does when she's upset.
say:9:1423370007:1.source_cn: 她往南边去了，我猜应该是去打猎了吧。她一不开心，就会去打猎。

say:10:1423370008:1.text: Thanks, Jules. Wait here. I'll find her and bring her back!
say:10:1423370008:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，朱尔，你先在这里等着，老师会把希娜找到带回来的！

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 你还记得希娜离开的方向吗？
